description: Campaign 027 deep hardening (user-invoked). Feature work is frozen. The orchestrator owns shared hotspots (agent/openspec state, scripts, docs, CI, package manifests, registry/generated files, theme, app chrome) and performs all cross-cutting convergence edits. Code packets own disjoint surfaces: H1 game correctness repairs, H2 performance/startup paths, H3 route/game reliability tests. Packet edits to versioned game logic must report the required game.json/version bumps to the orchestrator, who performs them with the registry regeneration.

parallelPackets.objective: Repair the audited correctness defects: vigilance stimulus lifetime, color-stroop dead actions, speed-color-match non-finite metric, spatial-coordinate-turn adaptive escalation, word-scramble dead budget; scan siblings for the same defect classes.
parallelPackets.completionCriteria: Each repair has a regression test that fails on the old behavior; version/provenance needs reported to the orchestrator; the affected game suites pass.
parallelPackets.validation: cd apps/mobile && npx tsc --noEmit && npx jest src/games/attention-sustained-vigilance src/games/flexibility-color-stroop src/games/speed-color-match src/games/spatial-coordinate-turn src/games/language-word-scramble

parallelPackets.objective: Bound the unbounded hot-path reads, version-gate steady-state bootstrap work, add dev-only phase marks, and fuse export canonicalization if byte-identical.
parallelPackets.completionCriteria: Named bounds documented; progression/analytics numbers unchanged under the existing suites; statement-count guard stays green; bootstrap test proves the version-gated skip and fail-closed first run.
parallelPackets.validation: cd apps/mobile && npx tsc --noEmit && npx jest src/progression src/analytics src/db src/data-portability src/__tests__/perf-db-query-patterns.test.ts

parallelPackets.objective: Close the audit's highest-value test gaps: session save-failure contract, math-value-ordering screen test, route failure paths (rewards, profile purchases, storage retry, workout advance, wipe, export write).
parallelPackets.completionCriteria: Each new test injects the failure and asserts user-visible handling plus state consistency; no trivial assertions; the full suite count grows with meaningful coverage.
parallelPackets.validation: cd apps/mobile && npx tsc --noEmit && npx jest src/app/__tests__ src/components/game-host/__tests__ src/games/math-value-ordering
